description: Hide or unhide a recipe, menu or list someone else shared with the user, from the user's own view only (nothing is deleted; the owner isn't told). list shows what is hidden (read-only). Can't hide the user's own items; use delete_recipe for those. Returns {hidden: true|false} or, for list, {hidden: [ids]}.

action.description: hide, unhide, or list hidden items

name: hide_shared
title: Hide something shared with me
